Name: Zichri, Father of Micah
Summary: Father of Micah the Levite, son of Asaph.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:15: Father of Micah the Levite, son of Asaph.
LifeLesson: The mention of Zichri in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
